name: Fastaval
blurb: Denmark's largest roleplaying and board-game congress, gathering about 1,000 people over Easter in Hobro each year.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Danmarks største rollespils- og brætspilskongres 24. MARTS - 29. MARTS 2027 Mariagerfjord Gymnasium, Hobro'

notes: Matches the seed note (Denmark's largest roleplaying/board-game congress, held over Easter; seed's ~1000-attendee figure comes from the site's own description). Organizer is the volunteer association 'Foreningen Alea', named in the site's own nav (Arrangør > Foreningen Alea). Fastaval names a single Guest of Honour per year; Paula Deming was that guest for 2026, described on her guest page as running a ttRPG one-shot and a 'Comedy Meets Board Games' talk with Fastaval attendees. Verify-03 pass (2026-10-05): stale -> none-yet -- the Guest of Honour page's own section heading still reads 'Guest of Honour at Fastaval 2026 Paula Deming' (not 2027), and her photo and the two program-session images are uploaded 2025/12 and 2026/02, i.e. material published for last year's show; the homepage confirms the 2027 edition's dates (24-29 March 2027, a 170-day countdown from today) but no 2027 Guest of Honour has been named yet, so guests resets to none-yet and the Paula Deming pick is removed.
